tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The screen ground of the Figma file.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and inputs raised above the screen ground.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: A control on the ground or on ivory under the pointer: the brand blue's tint (R10).

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: A control on the ground or on ivory while it is pressed (R10). A pressed state only: a selected item is designed with accent.

tokens.name: surface-raised-hover
tokens.usage: A control on a raised surface under the pointer (R10): one step deeper than on the ground, which white needs to show.

tokens.name: surface-raised-pressed
tokens.usage: A control on a raised surface while it is pressed (R10).

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Text and numbers are blue, as in the Figma file.

tokens.name: on-surface-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints and captions on the surfaces.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The logo, the app icon and decorative areas.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The brand orange on filled controls, bars and orange text; under the owner's contrast exception (architecture §9.5 R4).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: A primary control under the pointer: a deeper step of the brand orange (R10).

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: A primary control while it is pressed (R10).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Ivory labels on orange, as in the Figma file.

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Titles and section headings, in bold brand blue, as the identity package V1.1 sets them (owner, 2026-11-25).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand blue on filled secondary controls and selected states.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on accent.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines only; a control boundary uses border-strong.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundaries at 3:1: inputs, checkboxes, outlined buttons.

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: A control boundary under the pointer: the outline turns full blue (R10).

tokens.name: border-pressed
tokens.usage: A control boundary or an off track pressed: a deeper blue beyond the hover (R10).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring, at 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Delivered, paid, accepted: success text, icons and fills.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on success.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Delays and states that need attention soon.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on warning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, refusals and destructive actions.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: A danger control under the pointer (R10).

tokens.name: danger-pressed
tokens.usage: A danger control while it is pressed (R10).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on danger.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and tips.

tokens.name: on-info
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on info.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: The tint behind success text: a status chip, a free fee (D.9).

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: The tint behind warning text: a waiting status, a timer about to run out.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: The tint behind danger text: a refused or failed status, a late card.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: The tint behind info text and a running timer.

tokens.name: primary-subtle
tokens.usage: The tint behind orange status text (primary-pressed), a selected table row, a missing cover.

tokens.name: on-primary-subtle
tokens.usage: Orange status text on its tint («مع الكابتن»): the deepest orange step; blue in the captain app.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Text and icons of an inactive status: a cancelled order, a closed restaurant.

tokens.name: neutral-subtle
tokens.usage: The tint behind neutral text, and the skeleton's blocks.

tokens.name: nav-halo
tokens.usage: The soft halo round the floating bottom bar's outline (the Figma file's home, D.11); decoration, never text or a boundary.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: The yellow tone of a banner (a failed device check), apart from amber's warning (D.10).

tokens.name: caution-subtle
tokens.usage: The tint behind caution text.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs, sheets and drawers (D.10).

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Alerts read from across a room: 7:1.

tokens.name: on-alert
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on alert, at 7:1.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: The fill of a disabled control.

tokens.name: on-disabled
tokens.usage: The label of a disabled control.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: The first categorical chart series.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: The second categorical chart series.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: The third categorical chart series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: The fourth categorical chart series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: The fifth categorical chart series.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: The sixth categorical chart series.

tokens.name: space-none
tokens.usage: No gap.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Inside chips and between tight rows.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Between related items in a list or a form.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Card padding and the screen margin.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Between groups on a screen.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Around empty states and above a page title on the web.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: The largest gap, for wide web layouts.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small cards and image slots.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, badges, product cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cart items, totals, bars.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Banners and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and circles: buttons, search, tags, icon buttons.

tokens.name: elevation-low
tokens.usage: Cards resting on the ground.

tokens.name: elevation-medium
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and sticky bars.

tokens.name: elevation-high
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets over a scrim.

tokens.name: elevation-offset
tokens.usage: The flat orange shadow under orange banners and buttons; the soft ones are for overlays.

tokens.name: size-touch-target
tokens.usage: The minimum touch target (R4).

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: The Figma file's button height and icon-button diameter.

tokens.name: size-control-compact
tokens.usage: The compact button height for the admin panel and the restaurant portal (pointer devices only).

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: A small icon: inside chips, badges and dense rows; the stroke scales to 1.5/24 of it.

tokens.name: size-icon-md
tokens.usage: The default icon, drawn on the 24 grid: tabs, buttons, list rows.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: A large icon: empty states and the active circle of the floating bar.

tokens.name: size-selection
tokens.usage: The drawn checkbox and radio, centred in a touch target.

tokens.name: size-step
tokens.usage: The circles of the quantity stepper, centred in a touch target.

tokens.name: size-switch-width
tokens.usage: The switch track's width.

tokens.name: size-switch-height
tokens.usage: The switch track's height.

tokens.name: size-dialog
tokens.usage: A dialog's width; less the margins on a phone (D.10).

tokens.name: size-drawer
tokens.usage: The web side drawer's width (D.10).

tokens.name: size-toast
tokens.usage: A toast's width on the web (D.10).

tokens.name: size-tooltip
tokens.usage: A tooltip's widest line (D.10).

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: The panel and portal sidebar (D.10).

tokens.name: size-sidebar-collapsed
tokens.usage: The collapsed sidebar: icons only (D.10).

tokens.name: size-bar
tokens.usage: The top bar and the phone back bar (D.10).
